answers.core: I don't think that it can be done in an asset.
answers.workaround: Unfortunately, it cannot. `GodotPhysicsServer2D::CollCbkData` has support for a `valid_dir`, but that variable is only set in cpp (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/87f897ae0ad5a6770c6ee267e2f3458c89a06df7/modules/godot_physics_2d/godot_space_2d.cpp#L640 and elsewhere) and it is only set to `col_obj_shape_xform.columns[1].normalized()`. I cannot simply override the value of `col_obj_shape_xform.columns[1].normalized()`, as this has other implications.
